info.title: Pizza 4P's POS Cloud API
info.description: The public read API for the Pizza 4P's cloud. Generated from the handlers; see ADR-0019.

get.summary:
A store's per-trading-day activity rollups, oldest day first — answered from the materialised
rollup, never a log scan.
get.description:
Requires a valid API key with the `read_rollups` scope, and answers **only** for that key's
tenant: the tenant comes from the verified grant, never the request, so a caller can read a
store's rollups only if the store is within its own tenant. A `store_id` outside the tenant is
not an error — it simply has no rollup and reads back as an empty list.

200.description: Daily activity rollups, oldest day first

400.description: The store id is not a ULID

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or invalid

403.description: The API key lacks the read_rollups scope

DailyRollup.description:
A day's activity for one store, derived from the event log.

The cloud's dashboards answer from rollups rather than by scanning the raw log
(`docs/roadmap.md` P7). This first rollup counts events per store trading day and per event
type — enough for an activity dashboard, and it uses only envelope fields (`business_date`,
`event_type`), so it needs no per-event-type decoding. Money- and order-shaped rollups, and the
materialised tables that make the <10 ms dashboard query real, land with the dashboard slice.

by_type.description: Per-event-type counts, ordered by type so the output is deterministic.

total_events.description: Every event recorded on that day.

api_key.description: A scoped per-tenant API key, presented as `Authorization: Bearer pos_<id>_<secret>`.
